In the second part of the game your objective will be to protect a juicy cooked chicken to be mercilessly attacked by spiders or voracious wasps that emerge from everywhere. Your mission would be to shot at them before they can absorb its substance till just leaving the bones. But it will not be easy, as time goes on insects will be more numerous, so if you find it pertinent, you can request the help from a second player. Do not let them spoil your dish...

198624.overview:
TELLYWISE gives you the chance to control your own T.V. station.  Make or buy programmes, organise the programme schedule and most important of all - attract
the advertisers to your station.

198625.overview:
Temple of Terror is an adaptation of the Fighting Fantasy gamebook, Temple of Terror.

You are a solitary adventurer, chosen by the sage Yaztromo to save the land of Allansia from Malbordus, the sinister champion of the Dark Elves, by beating him through the inhospitable wastes of the Desert of Skulls to the fabulous lost city of Vatos. There you must brave cruel monsters, ancient deathtraps, fanatical disciples of the cult of Leesha, and the cat-and-mouse depredations of the sinister killer known as the Messenger of Death in your quest to recover the powerful Dragon artefacts before Malbordus can find them and utilise their mystical power to fuel his campaign of carnage.

198626.overview: Archie's daughter is dying of an incurable disease, and only by finding the 'Elixir of Healing' can she be saved from a slow and painful death. Two other explorers have tried and were never seen again. Can you succeed where others have failed?

198627.overview: Terry's Travels is a variant of the arcade game Frogger. This time it's a turtle called Terry that needs to be guided across heavily trafficked roads and log-jammed rivers in an attempt to reach home. The objective of the game is simply to reach the top of the screen in each level. The first level has the same layout as the game arcade with a road and a river. The next two levels are roads only or rivers only. The roads are busier than in most variants while the rivers have oil barrels that have to be avoided. The fourth level is completely different and involves moving through a maze. There are bad guys to avoid and a number of switches that open and close gates when moved over. The player has five lives and the game ends when they are all gone.

198629.overview:
This game covers the first 30 days of what was then feared to be the next war in Europe. You can choose to be the supreme commander of the NATO or the Warsaw Pact. In your control are air and ground units. These are backed up by your ability to make strategic nuclear/chemical attacks.

As the Warsaw Pact commander your task is to break the lines of the NATO alliance, which you see is a powerful invasion force, poised on your border. Your first task is to take over West Germany.

As NATO commander your task is to stop the Russian invasion. Hold the lines on West Germany's border. You will achieve this by preventing the occupation of West Germany.

Your computer opponent can play in three different ways. Nuclear weapons can be disabled for a Beginner game, while the thought processes can be either rational or unpredictable.

Gameplay is turn-based and primarily strategic, but some scenes can be played out in optional action sequences.

198630.overview: The idea of the game is to gain Therbo control and score a goal with it. Therbo is the name of the thermal ballistic object with which the game is played, as a football is used in soccer. Your opponent, which is computer controlled, and designated as the home team, will also try and gain Therbo control and score against you.

198631.overview:
Thrill Time Gold Vol.2 is a compilation of five games:

•  Airwolf
•  Scooby Doo
•  Battleships
•  Saboteur
•  Frank Bruno's Boxing

198632.overview:
Thrill Time: Platinum 1 is a collection of ten games:

Thundercats
Ikari Warriors
Buggy Boy
Beyond the Ice Palace
Hoppin' Mad
Overlander
Live and Let Die
Space Harrier
Great Gurianos
Dragon's Lair

198633.overview:
In a similar manner to Jewels of Darkness, this collection brings together three interlinked Level 9 adventures:

Lords of Time
Red Moon
The Price of Magik

The games have all been updated into the company's later adventure system, and have longer textual descriptions and some slight puzzle tweaks.

198634.overview:
It is the year 2997 A.D.  As you know world peace has been maintained for over half a millenium due to the foresight of our ancestors.  Over 500 years ago the
nations of Earth decided to remove all weapons of destrution by hiding them in the corridors of time.  It has now become known to us that one man threatens the stability of the world by locating these weapons.  Already he has perfected a vehicle capable of travelling within the time corridor and it is feared that he has begun his search. This man is ESMUND MADDISON.  A Time Pursuit Vehicle has been developed at our research  establishment but as yet has not been fully tested.  Your mission is to use the T.P.V. to locate and stop Maddison. Failure will mean the end of civilisation as we know it and your death!

198636.overview: You are out for a walk one day when you find yourself lost in a remote region of the forest. Instinctively you head towards a stream which you follow to to the mouth of a hidden cave. It is very dark inside and you decide it is best to go back downstream. Suddenly and evil looking old man orders you to enter the cave or he will kill you. He wants you to go inside the cave and find a golden ring which once belonged to him. He gives you a lamp and pushes you inside and says, "Do not linger child and heed the warnings of the Guardians!"  Frightened, you turn on the lamp and your adventures in the Time Tunnels begins.

198637.overview: Arcon and Zinnia, travellers in space and tlme, have been stranded on earth by a freak astro storm that has damaged their galactic exploration craft. Vital parts of their ship have been scattered over an area of 100 square kilometres of English countryside some have landed in different time zones, maklng their recovery extremely hazardous. To make matters even worse there are security forces from an enemy planet pursuing the travellers! You must take control of Arcon and Zinnia, instructing them separately as they move from location to location, interacting with the people they meet in the various time zones, with the obiect of recovering all their lost machine parts. 4D Timewreck — an adventure in space and time that will stretch you to the limit!

198639.overview:
Owing to an accident in warp-space your time capsule is spread across the aeons. 
Each time you land in a new era, new perils face you and you have to fight hard 
and fast to survive. As you collect the salvaged pieces of your craft you have 
more control over your destiny until you finally return to your own time. A very 
skilful Graphic Adventure. Runs in real time.

198640.overview:
The battle for Tobruk in May-July 1942 was one of the key battles of the North African front in World War 2. Rommel lead the Axis forces to a victory, taking out Allied forces which were gathered to densely mine a strategic defensive area of Libya. In this tactical wargame, players can do the same. Taking the six Allied supply points is crucial to your mission's success.

You must guide the movement and attacks of your units. You can also call in aircraft and engineer support. The game is turn-based; once you have given your orders, the Allies do the same. Unit damage is progressively calculated. Unlike the Allies, you use mobile suppliers, which you also command. They should be kept in range of your units (with no Allied forces in between).

The game includes optional action sequences, which can be practised outside the main game. You control navigation, driving and gunning (with turrets and machine guns) for individual units, from a first-person view.

198642.overview:
Top 10 Collection is a collection of ten games from Durell Software and Elite:

Saboteur
Saboteur II
Sigma 7
Critical Mass
Airwolf
Deep Strike
Combat Lynx
Turbo Esprit
Thanatos
Bombjack II

198643.overview:
During the battles between good and evil, a particularly evil character decided to overthrow the Dark One and take up his role. Unfortunately for him,
his efforts failed and he fled to an unsuspecting beautiful land.

And so began the dark age:

First of all he decided to call himself the Dark Lord, and to justify his title he plunged the land into eternal darkness. He then summoned all his evil followers to his empire, to be his servants. These servants wander throughout the land reporting back to their master anything out of the ordinary.

The High Council, the followers of good, decided not to let this pass and that good should be restored back to the land. They decided that this was a task only a small company could perform. Four characters have been asked to carry out this task, each chosen for their special talents. A Wizard, A Human, An Elf, and a Dwarf. The choice is theirs to take this task or not.

198645.overview:
Treble Champions is a football management game. The player can manage a squad, train players, and try to gain the way to the top of the leagues and cups. There are four divisions of 20 teams each and 1,500 (fictional) players with individual attributes are included in the game and purchasable for the manager. Beside the squad skills and injuries, the finances have to be managed for further progress in the game.

All menus and handling are presented in text based menus, mouse control is not supported. The matches are presented in text messages and an overview statistic about possession and shots. During the game, no interaction or intervention is possible. Loading and saving options are present. There are three difficulty levels and the player can chose in which league he wants to start (starting in the premier league is possible).

198646.overview: Trevor Brooking's World Cup Glory is a football managerial game that allows you to take charge of England to win the FIFA World Cup. You can select your squad and train them before moving onto the match. This is shown as lines of commentary with a clock ticking away. The game is text only with no graphics and the keyboard is used to enter your decisions.

198647.overview: A South American government, after long negotiations and extensive espionage activity, has managed to acquire the Positronic, a large-scale photonic cannon and one of the most powerful weapons the world has ever seen. The Positronic, coveted by many other countries, threatens the already tense peace in the area and has resulted in tensions escalating.  The only solution is a covert mission to destroy the Positronic at any cost and for this mission Charlie Montini - a Vietnam veteran with years of combat experience has been selected as the man to lead the charge.  Although a weapons expert and fierce fighter on his own merits, he'll be joined by both Humphrey Stallone and Billy Von Pettet - equally adept warriors with lots of jungle combat experience to assist in the extremely risky mission.  Together this unit, Codename: Triple Comando, will return to the jungle and rid the world of this fearsome cannon, before it's too late.

198648.overview:
The Tripods is a futuristic game where the world has been taken over by an alien race known as the Tripods and the humans are capped with a thought regulating device. A group of teenagers trying to avoid capping at the age of sixteen flee, in search for the white mountains which, as tales were told, is the human resistance against the Tripods. This takes them from England to France where the mountains are located.

It is an adventure game based on the BBC television series The Tripods broadcasted between 1984 and 1985. It mostly plays like a text adventure, but contains graphics too. Actions are selected from an action line showing the actions L (look left) / MV (move) / R (look right) / PK (items in the backpack) / HEALTH / 1 / 2 / EAT. Players select an action by pressing the corresponding key. Descriptions in text about the actions and the situation are shown near the bottom of the screen, below the graphics.

The bottom of the bar also has a bar showing the time left until nightfall. The game supports up to four players taking turns, so when night has come for one player, another player then gets to play. Another part involves avoiding Tripods while exploring. There are often multiple options to deal with a situation. For instance: you can attempt to hide from a Tripod or disorientate it by using a radio to upset its communication systems. This is tied to using specific items stored in the backpack.

198649.overview: Tritz is a new style game based on the complex strategy games devised by the ancient Chinese and Indians. This two-player game will give hours of enjoyment to gamesters of all ages, while testing their ability to outmanoeuvre their opponents.

198650.overview:
Trivia is a single player game designed to test your knowledge of lesser known
facts and figures.

The computer will ask you a series of questions and you must select your answer
in the time available.

On occasions a 'pass' option will be available and this allows you to move onto
the next question.

Each question answered correctly will complete a square on the score table. The
points awarded are displayed in the boxes. For each completed grid you will be
awarded an extra life. At the start of the game you will have two lives.

198651.overview:
Trivial Pursuit: Baby Boomer Edition is another add-on question pack for Domark's original Trivial Pursuit: Genus Edition for those who were born in the post-World War II era or people who enjoy 1960-70s nostalgia.

This pack gives players thousands more questions and adds these new categories: Broadcasting, Stage and Screen, Nightly News, Publishing, Life and Times, and RPM.

198652.overview:
Trivial Pursuit: Young Players Edition is the first add-on question pack for Domark's Trivial Pursuit: Genus Edition designed for children and teens.

This adds an additional 3,000 trivia questions separated into 2 age groups: 7 thru 12 & 12+. Original categories Sport & Leisure, Science & Nature, and Entertainment are replaced with People & Places, the Nature World and Games & Hobbies.

198653.overview:
I'd read a lot about home brewing, and decided to give it a try. I thought I'd buy a Chateaux Silver Soft Wine-making kit My first problem was gathering all the fruit. It's been years since I've ventured into the garden, and I didn't realise that things had become so overgrown! Perhaps the chemicals that! threw out from last years bio-engineering experiments turned that caterpillar into a man eater. Who knows?

Next problem. Sugar cubes. They used to be kept in a nice neat bag, but now..! They're scattered all over the larder, and to make things worse we seem to have guests in there as well. Funny place to keep a step-ladder too, but I suppose it did come in handy after I'd collected all the sugar. Anyway my next trip took me down into the cellar where the various pieces of equipment from Grandad's efforts were stored after he poisoned himself. The cellar should really be tidied up. It's almost impossible to see anything, let alone actually get hold of it... And it's full of extremely hungry bats.

The next weeks were spent carefully watching the fermentation process. I don't know who it was that kept leaving the windows open it was all I could do to keep them closed enough to get the temperature up again. The finished product took a long time to make; but the results were definitely worth it.

198654.overview: Do you follow the horses? Do you want to win more than you lose? Turf-form is a great horse racing simulation game that can also accept form data on each horse and using a highly-developed and accurate prediction routine suggest which horses have the best chances of winning the race.

198655.overview:
The year is A.D. 2795. The last eight hundred years have borne witness to no fewer than four thermo-nuclear wars, and now after almost two centuries of struggling to survive successive plagues, natural disasters and attacks from horribly mutated predators, the last remaining humanoids are dead! The only heritage that Mankind has left behind are the ruins of once proud cities and a radiation-sick world glowing with a constant fluorescent twilight.

The land is alive with animal species, all mutations; the seas are stagnant and dead! Lured by the radiation emanating from the once blue and green Earth, an alien vessel enters the solar system. As galactic wardens of Infinite wisdom, they decree that one of the remaining races on Earth should be helped to survive. Due to its hard shell a certain species of Turtle emerges unscathed from the holocaust. The aliens protect certain of the brick houses left across the world by the humanoids: they also leave a number of Time Gates behind before they finally turn around and leave the solar system as unobtrusively as they came.

Food, is scarce, and the mutations quickly learn that the only source of clean nourishment is Turtle Flambe! As the largest and strongest of the turtles, it is your duty to find and carry all other turtles to the security of the "Safe Houses". As each land is secured, you must use the Time Gates left by the aliens to warp yourself to other lands and other dimensions in order that Turtledom might survive.

198656.overview:
TV Special is a compilation of three games based on popular UK television shows of the 1980s:

-  Every Second Counts
-  Blockbusters
-  The Krypton Factor

198657.overview:
Twice Shy is a thriller written by Dick Francis and published in 1981. This game is a text based adventure that puts you in the role of Jonathan Derry, a physics teacher in a comprehensive school in the south of England. Dick Francis is famed for his complex thrillers based around the English horse racing scene and this game is based around one of his classics. Without giving too much of the plot away, the story is based around some Spectrum software cassettes, horse racing and the bad guys who want them. As well as the adventure game itself there is a racing game which can be run either independently as a free-standing game, or part of the adventure, when the game requires the player to go to a race-course to look for clues.

The text interpreter is easy to use and has a wide vocabulary. It accepts simple commands such as Go South, South and even 'S' as well as more complex combined commands such as 'Go south, east, north and open the door'. Commands can be given to other game characters by typing "Say to Jane 'Tell me about Ted'", and "Sarah 'Go south and open the door'"

It is possible to save the game and restart from a saved position.

198658.overview: In Type-Rope, the player enters the role of Mistertronic, who has to rescue his friends who have been captured by a dreaded thread. To untie the captured characters the player has to remove each thread by typing in the letters and numbers that appear on each side of each thread. When all threads are gone the character is free, and the game moves on to the next. The player earns points for each thread he unties, and the quicker he is, the more points will he get. For each character there's a time limit. This gets shorter for every rescued character.

198659.overview: In Tyrant of Athens the player becomes the ruler of a Greek city-state. The game starts in Athens, Vth century BCE, surrounded by rival Greek cities and the hostile Persian Empire. The gameplay is similar to that of Hammurabi - each year the player must make decisions vital to the survival of the polis: choosing the number of troops to train, warships and merchant ships to built, units of food to export/import (to sustain the population), to how many allies grant the citizenship (yet they may desert or even rebel) - all of the above makes expenses from the treasury. You'll also respond to attacking armies/fleets (whether to fight back or pay them a tribute). The game plays up to 30 turns, but may end earlier if you suffer disasters and defeats.

199550.overview: Timebomb is a simple arcade game (but thinking is very helpful). The player must diffuse six timebombs, before the time runs out. He can only move on blue squares (disappearing after single stepping - player can stuck with no any possibility of moves), and must avoid the skulls and boots. Each bomb a has time limit. The player has 3 lives - if he lost all lives, the game is over.

199616.overview:
The Time Machine is the second in the Mysterious Adventure series of text adventures by Brian Howarth. You are a newspaper reporter, come to investigate the eccentric professor who lives all by himself out on the moors. You start the game in a swamp and must find your way to an old manor house. When you get there, you find the place deserted, though. Ultimately, you must rescue the professor by finding 3 missing prisms which control his time machine, which are lost in time. Items found in one destination sometimes have to be used in another.

As the other games in the series, the game uses an interpreter similar to the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also has the same limitations - a basic 2-word parser, limited vocabulary, and brief descriptions. Illustrations are included in Spectrum, C64, Dragon and Oric ports.

199939.overview:
Trzy Wymiary is a Polish language maths/science program for the ZX Spectrum.

It was developed by Robert W. Heron and published by Krajowe Wydawnictwo Czasopism in 1987.

200146.overview: The object of the game is to collect all ten little indians, which are figurines amounting to a fantastic fortune. It starts unconventionally enough inside a train carriage with no apparent way out, especially as you can see the countryside whizzing past the windows. After a certain number of goes the train crashes! Getting the train to stop takes some experimenting, but when it does, it pulls up at the station of Lower Massington, which turns out to be another problem, in as much as the game really gets going in Upper Massington, in the manor house which belonged to the late Major Johnston-Smythe! Here the fabulous gold figurine is hidden, but so are ten identical ones made from worthless metals which will guide you to the fortune itself. Be warned, many other fortune hunters have had a go and never been heard from again. Usual on/off text/graphics fadllty of Digital Fantasia games, and a convoluted plot worthy of Agatha Christie in this highly recommended adventure.

200376.overview:
The inhabitants of Transylvania are very concerned about a strange
plague that has been ravaging this region for some time and killing
many of its inhabitants.

They think the origin of this plague is related to Count Dracula, a
strange being who lives in a castle near the town, from which no one
has ever returned.
To solve this enigma and end this plague, they have hired a professor
specializing in "rare cases", Professor Van Helsin.

Unfortunately, the carriage in which our brave professor was traveling
on the way to the castle, the supposed origin of this disease, has
suffered an accident, and when he woke up, he found some strange
marks on his neck, an unequivocal sign that he has also contracted this
terrible evil.

200377.overview:
Translyvanian Castle 2 takes a visual turn to become something more similar to an Eye of the Beholder. Gone are the flat screens, now we have a first-person view of the maze; Objects and enemies can be seen from a distance and we can avoid an attack if we wish. 

Speaking of attacks, the game not only handles attack and defense values, but also allows equipping multipliers such as weapons, shields, helmets. Items can be found by the labyrinth or left behind by downed enemies. 

We can carry up to nine, but the game also allows us to leave those that do not have immediate use, to come back to look for them later. Among the elements of attack and defense that we mentioned before, we can also find potions and wands with different powers.

200430.overview:
Of all the versions of Tetris created for the ZX Spectrum, Tetris 2 by Frantisek Fuka is probably the best. It not only incorporates the possibility of two simultaneous players, extra pieces and special levels, but it also implements many of the improvements in gameplay of the arcade and consoles, such as the controlled drop of pieces and the possibility of correcting positions at the last moment.

Now TheShich presents us with an extensive modification to the version of Viktor Drozd (with extra levels), which is still in development but already includes juicy modifications.

201158.overview:
Caves full of Tourmaline crystals have always attracted treasure hunters.
With an anti-gravity suit and some quality dynamite you are going to join their ranks.
Be warned, the ancient inhabitants of these caves do not appreciate the company of the likes of you.
They will do their best to hide the crystals and to destroy you!

201167.overview:
The idea of each screen is to destroy all enemy pods and direct
the laser beam into the receiver. To actually direct the beam
you can use a mirrors by draging it over a screen.

Good Luck!

201543.overview:
Tenebra Macabre is a game made in a single day for Halloween. Mega Meghan has been locked up in a dark crypt by Jurufranto Morante. The only way out is by activating magic candles in each room. The game revisits a gameplay element previously explored in some areas of Phantomas Tales #4: Severin Sewers by the same developer where the entire room is dark and only a small radius around the character is visible. Fortunately there are flashes of lightning every now and then that light up the entire room briefly.

The game contains a single level that consists of several single-screen rooms combined using the flip-screen mechanic. Each room contains a single candle. Mega Meghan has to complete platforming sections while avoiding enemies as she has no means of attack. The visible radius around her is in colour, but once the candle has been found the entire room is revealed and the screen is rendered monochromatic. There are 24 candles to be found and she starts with nine lives.

201544.overview:
The CORNEJAL kingdom was living its golden days with parties, banquets, tournaments, theater festivals, games and laughs, lots of laughs. A haven of peace in the world. Despite that they had an army, because on some occasion of their history they had to fight against invaders. The army was an elite that only those who could fly could access. For the rest were the rest of jobs. TEODORO couldn't fly and he became the jester, regardless of the fact that he always wanted to be a soldier.

But those happy days came to an end. An strange army that came from nothing suddenly attacked the castle and before they could react everything was lost. Soldiers dissapeared in an instant and only King RUI and TEODORO were left.

The desperate king, while being carried away over shoulders, implored that someone went up to the highest tower to fire the alarm flame to warn the rest of kingdoms that an enemy was attacking.

TEODORO was the last survivor and, despite being just a lowly jester, wanted to try the complex task...

201549.overview:
It has been 3 years since a dreadful war nearly brought the planet of Atlantis to its knees. Cities still lay in ruins.

Throughout the galaxy, rumours of hidden treasures persist and so Lady Mandrill has dispatched Spectra to explore the underwater ruins and bring back any riches that can be found.

Arriving at Atlantis, Spectra parks her ship in orbit above the worst hit areas. At least here there is less chance of running into the Atlantean army which are still busy rebuilding the central city hubs.

Spectra settles down into the secondary cockpit and flicks a couple of switches - her micro-submersible (which she lovingly nicknamed 'Baby Gulp') detaches from the ship and splashes down into the planetary ocean below.

The bubbles rise, the searchlights flick on. Now to begin the hunt...

201569.overview:
On weekends, octopus visiting her beloved grandmother... Grandma loves her grandchildren and always pleased. We came the next weekend, but my mother had accumulated a lot of homework, and my dad octopus has not come home from work. What to do? Grandma is waiting for them. Dad usually accompanies them to it... After all, they are still inexperienced, and their own can not reach.Should be asked to help nurse jellyfish, I thought my mother. Babysitting gladly accepted, because it is with them from birth...

Jumping on jellyfish help kids Octopussy alternately move to his grandmother.

201576.overview:
Find the three pieces of the key that opens the door of the mansion and escape before you run out of energy and disappear to forever.

Use the objects wisely and ration the meals.

Avoid and destroy enemies, although not all die
when firing them...

201618.overview:
Brrrrr it's getting cold and winter is racing towards us.
Toofy needs to collect enough nuts to make it through but the nasty squirrels have raided his store and stolen them.
Guide Toofy as he tries to reclaim his nuts and survive the winter.

201620.overview:
Toofy is asleep, surrounded by his collection of nuts. Suddenly they all vanish, and evil monsters start throwing them away.

He jumps out of bed, and has to collect them as they fall.

Toofy was in a nightmare.. and to get out of it, he had to collect enough nuts and find his way home.

201644.overview:
Time has passed and chaos reigns in the worlds of Topo Soft. That sheriff, who 30 years ago had liberated the people of Aleantes, has become the worst tyrant in history. The secondary characters of the Topo games have seen their opportunity to receive the protagonism that belonged to them and that was taken away.

Sheriff Bill MacColl had kept them subdued by promising to give them the role of their lives. Then came the 8-bit crisis and they resigned themselves to the greatest forgetfulness.

Now the retro returns and, the forgotten characters, rebel against the power usurped by the evil sheriff, prepare to free themselves from the oppressive yoke. Private Yuri Dimitrov of R.A.M. It will be who will lead the search and execution of the tyrant MacColl. Not in vain he, and not FOX, was the one who should have played the role of "good". But in Topo they mixed the roles and the poor soldier was assigned to be massacred and humiliated throughout the game. Now Dimitrov has the opportunity to enter the lair of the evil sheriff to free the games from his terrible dictatorship.

Only you can help Yuri regain his lost honor, but beware, MacColl's bunker is full of traps and henchmen willing to defend their boss from him at all costs.

201645.overview: Torreoscura is an original conversational adventure by Bieno Marti made with The Quill (Gilsoft) in its versions for Commodore 64, Amstrad CPC and ORIC and with DAAD (Adventures AD) in its ports for ZX Spectrum, MSX, Amstrad PCW and PC MS- TWO CGA.

201699.overview:
Help Andres the trash man do his diary job, pick up the bins, bring them to the lorry, empty them and put them back where they were.
The bins are numbered and you must pick them in order.

201702.overview:
Traxtor and Return of Traxtor is a compilation of The Legend of Traxtor (Side A) + The Return of Traxtor (Side B). 
Match 3 or more tiles to destroy them before they reach to your defence line!

202630.overview: Having started participating in amateur racing in Sweden in the 50s, you will go through an amazing story through decades, watching the development of the automotive industry and the life of one family.

203859.overview:
The Tomb of Dracula is an arcade adventure where the aim is to explore vaults over various levels of Dracula's Tomb to find the Vampire's Treasure worth half a million pounds. At the start of the game you are presented, for a limited time, a map of the first level of 300 vaults showing all the obstacles, monsters and stakes which needs memorizing before it disappears. You move about in a North, South, East or West direction which is shown in a 1st person perspective. You are then told what is in that vault every time you move into it.

As well as the empty vaults, you will discover there are also zombies and ghouls which will need killing with your limited supply of stakes to move on. Slime pits are there to be fallen into and once again stakes are needed to survive. To help you there are vaults full of stakes because if you don't have enough stakes then it is game over. After 30 minutes of exploring, Dracula himself will wake up and stand in the vault next to you. As you move, he will follow and clear the room of any stakes if any are in there. If you walk into a vault containing Dracula, then he needs to be killed, but he will rise again and place himself next to your vault again.

Occasionally you will be presented with the choice to look at the map again, but this will cost you stakes if you choose to look. To move onto the next level, you have to find a staircase and this will also give you extra stakes.

207407.overview: This game is a Visual Novel, that is, you can play by selecting options, as if it were a game-book. It is inspired by H.G. Wells' 1895 book The Time Machine and the graphics have been redrawn from frames from George Pal's classic 1960 film.

207811.overview:
The World War Simulator: Part II. In the year 3000, video games are so advanced that people can fulfil virtually any fantasy they desire. In this game you play as Richard Burton as he attempts to infiltrate Hitler's bunker and assassinate him. Not only him, but his mistress Eva Braun, Goebbels and others.

To see the best ending in the history of video games you must complete 100% of the trophies.

211201.overview: Two students of the famous Thieves School have failed their exam. The professors have decided to give them one more chance, a delictive tour around the world, in which they will face dangerous situations while they steal valuable objects of any kind. Help them to graduate!

211279.overview:
Being the cousin of a famous ape is not easy. You are always compared to him whatever you do. Now, your girlfriend wants to test you and has decided to kidnap herself and go with the most thug monkey in Jujuland: Monolete. 
You will not tolerate this, and you will fight against every creature that dares to cross your path. You will recover your beautiful ape friend to show how cool you are, and she will never call you Tokimal again.

213629.overview: TCQ  (also known as /\O[] or Triangle, Circle, Square) is a brand-new platformer for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Amaweks and published by Teknamic Software on July 1, 2022.

217337.overview: Trans-Europe Rally is a simple 1-2 player top-down racer for the multiple systems which released exclusively in Spain. This is the ZX Spectrum version.

218658.overview: Tiny Touch 'n' Go is an educational typing game/tutor for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Goldstar and published by Sinclair Research themselves in 1984.

219152.overview: They Say the World will Die in Fire and Ice is a text adventure with simple graphics for the ZX Spectrum. The game is centered around Greek mythology, and was developed and published by Electric Software in 1984.

420736.overview:
You are Humgruffin, a troll who has been transported to the Netherworld of Narc a land full of Goblins and crystals and ceilings to walk on. The only chance to escape is to reverse a spell that put him there. In each chamber is a crystal which needs to be collected and put in an amulet. You need to avoid the Goblins or being trapped by walls built by them. If you touch a Goblin then you start to turn to stone and transported elsewhere in Narc. To help you on your quest you can make holes appear in the ground for you to fall through into another part of Narc or make a Goblin disappear. You can use other objects as well and these include Pyramids (to jump up to the ceiling), Toadstools (summons a Dwarf to make holes in the floor) and Die (to make a random hole).

Troll is a 3D isometric game which shows both the floor and ceiling that can be walked on. The game is viewed at an elevated angle. The joystick or keyboard can be used and as well as the main playing area you can also see the icons you need to help you on your quest.

447093.overview:
In the midst of a war, the enemy is developing a new weapon, a technologically perfect tank with which to win the war and subject your faction to slavery. Drive your T54 tank and find it, along the way collect the 5 charges of T.N.T. necessary for its destruction before the enemy puts it into operation and it is too late for you and yours.

Once the charges have been placed, return to your base to complete the mission and you will have saved your country.

Slavery and total submission or the freedom of your country depends on you, you decide...you choose...if you can...

448359.overview:
Trojan was a Capcom arcade title which was due for conversion across to the likes of the ZX Spectrum in 1987. Tasked with the conversion for Elite Software was Durell Software.

For years, much was unknown about it – until in more recent years it was established that Rob Hubbard had composed a some tunes for a game called Trojan. Clive Townsend then confirmed he had also developed the Spectrum edition, and had all of his Microdrive disks backed up by Steve Brown of TZX Vault- which revealed playable remains of the game.

448708.overview:
It was a game announced in MicroHobby magazine No. 196, programmed in 1989 by Silicon Games and that was going to be (or was) published by Dro Software. The fact is that to date nothing was known about the Spectrum version other than that information.

The magazine's editor provided a version of this game. It is the conversion by Xortrapa Soft. Group that has games like Triple Comando and Mr. Gas to its credit.

There is only PHASE 1. What we do not know is if they only sent PHASE 1 to MicroHobby for their comments or only this phase was preserved.

450282.overview:
This Compilation Includes
A View to a Kill: The Computer Game (1985)
 Beaky and the Egg Snatchers (1984)
 Codename MAT II (1985)
 Friday the 13th (1986)
 The Pyramid (1983)

450924.overview: Traxx is a simple action game, with 9 speed settings and a 2 player mode. You are presented with a grid of 24 squares, each of which has lines around it, and your task is to colour in the whole grid. this is done by moving across these lines so as to colour each square individually. If you overshoot the one of the edges, or are forced to go into a different direction, you lose any lines which have been coloured on that block. Each square that you colour must already be next to one which is already coloured, but any sides which have already been used as part of another completed row needn't be re-coloured. Trying to stop you doing this are up to 9 aliens, each of which costs you a life on contact. After completing a level you get 10 seconds to eat the aliens for points, a lá Pac-Man.

451117.overview:
This Compilation Includes
Avenger (1986)
Bounder (1985)
Footballer of the Year (1986)
Future Knight (1986)
Highway Encounter (1985)
Jack the Nipper (1986)
Krakout (1987)
Monty on the Run (1985)
Trailblazer (1986)
West Bank (1985)

451456.overview:
Taito Coin-Op Hits is a compilation of eight conversions of Taito coin-ops:

Arkanoid
Arkanoid: Revenge of Doh
Bubble Bobble
Flying Shark
Legend of Kage
Rastan
Renegade
Slap Fight

451464.overview:
The Tengen Trilogy is a compilation of three computer games originally published under the Tengen label.

Cyberball
Escape from the Planet of the Robot Monsters
Klax

453269.overview:
Tron,  is a single-player Tron Light Cycles game for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum.

It was developed by J.D. Woodcock and S. Wilson and was published by Blaby Computer Games in 1984.

453614.overview:
An evil Necromancer holds the land of Twilight in fear. Three brave heroes set out into the ancient dungeons to put an end to his evil deeds...

Tiny Dungeons it's a small roguelite game for ZX Spectrum 128

454518.overview:
Time Bandits is a rather graphically simplistic 1-player arcade adventure for the 16K ZX Spectrum.

The game was developed and published by Newsoft Products in 1982.

458699.overview:
Es noche de Navidad cuando nuestro protagonista despierta en la quietud helada de su hogar, solo para descubrir que su familia ha desaparecido sin dejar rastro. Todo apunta a un oscuro secreto familiar, un misterio que ignora pero que carga un peso inmenso: la responsabilidad de proteger no solo su vida, sino el destino de otros.

A medida que la noche avanza, las sombras de su propio linaje comienzan a revelarse junto a verdades que pondrán a prueba su ingenio y su voluntad de sobrevivir. Mientras seres oscuros de antiguas leyendas irrumpen en el edificio, deberá descubrir el secreto que se oculta entre las paredes, salir con vida y salvar a quienes aún pueda encontrar a lo largo de su camino. Un desafío que podría cambiarlo todo.

458700.overview:
A star has ripped through the night sky and fallen to earth. Soon after, lonely irrintzis echo among the mountains, like a warning that no one can fully understand.

Since then, something has been unleashed.

Verocious shadows roam the valleys and peaks. They are not simple enemies with steel. Alongside them, hostile men also advance, coming from other lands or born of the

459777.overview:
Troon is a simple 1-2 player golf game for the 48K Sinclair ZX Spectrum.

The game was developed and published by Hornby Software in 1983.

460866.overview:
Balloon Hopper is a game designed for the ZX Spectrum, created by Andrew Foord. It was first published as a type-in game in the September 1983 issue of Your Computer magazine.

The game was subsequently released under two different titles in Spain: "Don Pepe y los Globos" by Paraninfo Soft and "Transporte Aéreo" by A.V.R. Additionally, it was titled "Octopus" in Germany, where it was published by Hanesoft.

462347.overview:
From Czechoslovakia comes the ultimate version of Soviet computer game.

Bumfun Software rereleased the game in 2016.

462365.overview:
Cricket game originally published by Bug-Byte Software, and then released as part of a covertape for Your Sinclair magazine. Bug-Byte then rereleased the game with several bug fixes. 

Not to be confused with Robin Smith's International Cricket, which was published by Challenge Games, or Graham Gooch's Test Cricket, which was published by Audiogenic. Both are different, unrelated games.

462998.overview: The second part of the Ket Trilogy. The game was preceeded by Mountains of Ket and followed by The Final Mission.

463510.overview:
Home is the 11th planet of Betelgeux now looming bright orange on
your scanners.

You think back - the last remaining member of G-Force - an expeditionary
force sent to cross the great divide to Andromeda.

Suddenly your scanners flare - your signal is no longer recognised.
"ARATIS WAS RIGHT"

Travelling faster than light, you have time jumped! You've been away from
home a million years. Unrecognisable patterns - an attack gate - hemming
you in.

463511.overview: Tenebra is an atmospheric puzzle game with rogue-like elements. Guide the hapless protagonist to the exit, but also keep in mind that he is afraid of darkness and refuses to walk in the dark areas.

463934.overview:
Treasure Hunt is a game for one or two players. Whilst playing this game keep a finger over each of the control keys. Don't take your eyes off the screen to move one finger from key to key.

Can you grab the treasure before your opponent does? How much treasure can you find in three minutes? Will you get lost in the invisible maze? 144 game variations and lots of different mazes.

472970.overview:
A Spectrum pastiche shamelessly AI coded, and shamelessly inspired by SABRE WULF and ATIC ATAC from the legendary ULTIMATE PLAY THE GAME.

Story inside the game!

Keep an eye on your health and stamina. You can check their status on both sides of your old pocket watch.

When hunger strikes, you can eat any junk — but don't say you weren't warned.

Rest to recover stamina. But don't stay still for too long — the boogeyman is coming.

Drink water from wells to fully restore your health and stamina. It will also reverse any toxic effect from the s**t you may have eaten. But beware: any active power-up effect will be washed out as well.

Although you are free to get lost exploring the world, the game is linear. You must reach the objectives in sequence. To find your way, you have three items at your disposal:

  -The default compass will always be available. But it only points toward the next objective — it doesn't tell you how to get there through the world's layout.
  -The magic compass does show you which exact path to take to reach the next objective. But its effect doesn't last long.
  -A map that you will find randomly thorugh the game. Be quick every time you pick it up, the wind carries it away fast!

You have unlimited time. But every passing day the creatures and monsters will become faster and more aggresive.

Good luck, and finish it, will you!
